scope: One-session LLM-as-judge audit of factual prose claims, not model classification predictions
judge: GPT-6 (ChatGPT conversational evaluation, 2026-11-02); outputs transcribed during preparation; no API-based replication available
rubric: Supported iff claim follows from the project data and methodology; Unsupported if directly contradicted; Unverifiable for claims that require unprovided evidence

items.claim: Iris has thirteen measured input features.
The Wine dataset was independently collected for this assignment.
The study uses ten repeats of five-fold stratified cross-validation.
Fisher's 1936 paper reported the same 97.87 percent held-out cross-validation accuracy.
items.basis: this is a modern evaluation protocol

items.claim: An Iris-trained classifier can directly classify Wine without changing the feature schema.
The public repository is accessible to every marker without login.
items.basis: link exists in conversation, but access for every marker not tested

items.claim: For the Iris LDA confusion matrix, errors occur between versicolor and virginica.
The evidence establishes causal superiority of LDA in all botanical applications.
items.basis: observational benchmark cannot support universal causal claim

limitations: No repeated judge sampling, no human comparison, no judge API, no independent verification or inter-rater reliability; judge evaluations are a small demonstration only.
